title: Voice Activity Detector
text: Detect presence of speech in audio signal, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Window} sets Windowing function applied before FFT; {Domain of the input}, {Sidelobe attenuation of the window (dB)}, {Inherit FFT length from input dimensions} sets the fFT length to number of input samples, {FFT length} sets the number of bins in frequency domain, {Probability of transition from a silence frame to a speech frame} sets the probability that a speech frame follows a silence, {Probability of transition from a speech frame to a silence frame} sets the probability that a silence frame follows a speech, {Output noise variance} sets the output estimate of noise variance per frequency and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: P
ports.summary: Probability that speech is present scalar | row vector

ports.name: N
ports.summary: Estimate of noise variance per frequency bin column vector | matrix

params.name: Domain of the input
params.values: Domain of the input Time (default) | Frequency

params.name: Window
params.values: Windowing function applied before FFT Hann (default) | Chebyshev | Flat Top | Hamming | Kaiser | Rectangular

params.name: Sidelobe attenuation of the window (dB)
params.values: Sidelobe attenuation of the window (dB) 60 (default) | positive finite scalar

params.name: Inherit FFT length from input dimensions
params.values: Set FFT length to number of input samples on (default) | off

params.name: FFT length
params.values: Number of bins in frequency domain 1024 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Probability of transition from a silence frame to a speech frame
params.values: Probability that a speech frame follows a silence frame 0.2 (default) | scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Probability of transition from a speech frame to a silence frame
params.values: Probability that a silence frame follows a speech frame 0.1 (default) | scalar in the range [0,1]

params.name: Output noise variance
params.values: Output estimate of noise variance per frequency bin off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Specify type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
